<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>CFA L1 — Equity Investments Master Guide | Midnight Scholar</title>
<style>
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
MIDNIGHT SCHOLAR — Design Tokens
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root{
--bg-deep:#0f0f23;
--bg-slate:#1a1a2e;
--bg-navy:#0f3460;
--card-bg:#1e1e3f;
--card-border:#2a2a4a;
--cyan:#00d9ff;
--coral:#e94560;
--emerald:#2ecc71;
--amber:#f39c12;
--gold:#f1c40f;
--red:#e74c3c;
--text:#e8e8e8;
--muted:#9a9ab8;
--sidebar-w:280px;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg-deep) 0%,var(--bg-slate) 100%);
background-attachment:fixed;
color:var(--text);
font-size:0.95rem;
line-height:1.7;
}
section{scroll-margin-top:24px;}

/* ══════════════ TYPOGRAPHY ══════════════ */
h1{
font-size:2.8rem;
line-height:1.2;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffffff 0%,var(--cyan) 40%,#ffffff 70%,var(--cyan) 100%);
background-size:200% auto;
-webkit-background-clip:text;
background-clip:text;
-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
color:transparent;
animation:title-shine 7s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes title-shine{to{background-position:200% center;}}
h2{font-size:1.6rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;}
h3{font-size:1.15rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px;}
h4{font-size:1rem;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;}
p{margin-bottom:12px;}
strong{color:#fff;}
ul{margin:0 0 12px 22px;}
li{margin-bottom:8px;}
.muted{color:var(--muted);}

/* ══════════════ LAYOUT ══════════════ */
.sidebar{
position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;
width:var(--sidebar-w);
background:rgba(15,15,35,0.92);
border-right:1px solid var(--card-border);
overflow-y:auto;
padding:28px 0 40px;
z-index:50;
scrollbar-width:thin;
scrollbar-color:var(--card-border) transparent;
}
.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;}
.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--card-border);border-radius:3px;}
.brand{padding:0 24px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--card-border);margin-bottom:18px;}
.brand-title{
color:var(--coral);
font-weight:800;
font-size:1.15rem;
letter-spacing:3px;
}
.brand-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:2px;}
.nav-section{margin-bottom:20px;}
.nav-heading{
padding:0 24px;
font-size:0.68rem;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:2px;
color:var(--muted);
margin-bottom:8px;
}
.nav-link{
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
padding:9px 24px 9px 21px;
color:var(--text);
text-decoration:none;
font-size:0.86rem;
border-left:3px solid transparent;
transition:background 0.2s ease,border-color 0.2s ease,color 0.2s ease;
}
.nav-link:hover{background:rgba(0,217,255,0.05);color:var(--cyan);}
.nav-link.active{
border-left-color:var(--cyan);
background:rgba(0,217,255,0.05);
color:var(--cyan);
}
.los-pill{
flex-shrink:0;
font-size:0.62rem;
font-weight:700;
letter-spacing:1px;
padding:2px 8px;
border-radius:999px;
background:rgba(0,217,255,0.12);
color:var(--cyan);
border:1px solid rgba(0,217,255,0.3);
}
.los-pill.pill-coral{background:rgba(233,69,96,0.12);color:var(--coral);border-color:rgba(233,69,96,0.3);}
.los-pill.pill-amber{background:rgba(243,156,18,0.12);color:var(--amber);border-color:rgba(243,156,18,0.3);}
.los-pill.pill-green{background:rgba(46,204,113,0.12);color:var(--emerald);border-color:rgba(46,204,113,0.3);}

.main{margin-left:var(--sidebar-w);padding:0 0 80px;}
.content{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 36px;}

@media (max-width:900px){
.sidebar{display:none;}
.main{margin-left:0;}
.content{padding:0 18px;}
h1{font-size:2rem;}
}

/* ══════════════ HERO ══════════════ */
.hero{
position:relative;
overflow:hidden;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg-deep) 0%,var(--bg-navy) 60%,var(--bg-slate) 100%);
border-bottom:1px solid var(--card-border);
padding:70px 36px 56px;
margin-bottom:40px;
}
.hero::before{
content:"";
position:absolute;top:-120px;right:-100px;
width:420px;height:420px;
background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(233,69,96,0.2) 0%,transparent 70%);
pointer-events:none;
}
.hero::after{
content:"";
position:absolute;bottom:-140px;left:-80px;
width:380px;height:380px;
background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,217,255,0.12) 0%,transparent 70%);
pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-inner{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.hero-tag{
display:inline-block;
font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--coral);
border:1px solid rgba(233,69,96,0.4);
background:rgba(233,69,96,0.08);
padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;
margin-bottom:18px;
}
.hero-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.05rem;max-width:680px;margin:14px 0 28px;}
.meta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;}
.meta-card{
background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
border-radius:12px;
padding:14px 20px;
backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
font-size:0.88rem;
}
.meta-card .mc-icon{font-size:1.3rem;}
.meta-card .mc-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;display:block;}
.meta-card .mc-value{color:#fff;font-weight:700;}

/* ══════════════ SECTION HEADERS ══════════════ */
.section-head{margin:56px 0 24px;}
.section-eyebrow{
font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:6px;
}
.section-head p{color:var(--muted);max-width:760px;}
.section-rule{
height:2px;border:0;margin:14px 0 0;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),transparent 70%);
opacity:0.5;
}

/* ══════════════ CARDS ══════════════ */
.card{
background:var(--card-bg);
border-radius:16px;
padding:28px;
margin-bottom:24px;
border:1px solid var(--card-border);
box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
transition:transform 0.3s ease,box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}
.card:hover{
transform:translateY(-3px);
box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
animation:pulse-glow 2s infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse-glow{
0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,217,255,0.2);}
50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px 5px rgba(0,217,255,0.1);}
}
.mini-card{
background:var(--card-bg);
border-radius:12px;
padding:20px;
border:1px solid var(--card-border);
}
.mini-card.accent-green{border-left:3px solid var(--emerald);}
.mini-card.accent-red{border-left:3px solid var(--coral);}
.mini-card.accent-amber{border-left:3px solid var(--amber);}
.mini-card.accent-cyan{border-left:3px solid var(--cyan);}
.grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:24px;}
.grid-2 > .card,.grid-2 > .mini-card{margin-bottom:0;}
@media (max-width:760px){.grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ══════════════ TABLES ══════════════ */
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:16px 0;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--card-border);}
.comparison-table,.summary-table{
width:100%;
border-collapse:separate;
border-spacing:0;
min-width:560px;
}
.comparison-table th{
background:var(--bg-navy);
color:var(--cyan);
padding:16px 20px;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:1px;
font-size:0.72rem;
text-align:left;
}
.summary-table th{
background:var(--bg-deep);
color:var(--cyan);
padding:16px 20px;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:1px;
font-size:0.72rem;
text-align:left;
}
.comparison-table td,.summary-table td{
padding:16px 20px;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--card-border);
background:rgba(30,30,63,0.5);
vertical-align:top;
font-size:0.9rem;
}
.comparison-table tr:last-child td,.summary-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
.comparison-table tbody tr:hover td,.summary-table tbody tr:hover td{background:rgba(0,217,255,0.05);}
.feature-col{color:var(--amber);font-weight:600;width:25%;}
td .cell-title{color:#fff;font-weight:700;display:block;margin-bottom:2px;}
td .cell-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.83rem;}

/* ══════════════ RISK BADGES ══════════════ */
.risk-badge{
display:inline-block;
padding:4px 12px;
border-radius:999px;
font-size:0.68rem;
font-weight:700;
letter-spacing:1px;
text-transform:uppercase;
white-space:nowrap;
}
.risk-high{background:rgba(231,76,60,0.15);color:var(--red);border:1px solid rgba(231,76,60,0.3);}
.risk-mod-high{background:rgba(243,156,18,0.15);color:var(--amber);border:1px solid rgba(243,156,18,0.3);}
.risk-moderate{background:rgba(241,196,15,0.15);color:var(--gold);border:1px solid rgba(241,196,15,0.3);}
.risk-low{background:rgba(46,204,113,0.15);color:var(--emerald);border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);}
.risk-lowest{background:rgba(0,217,255,0.15);color:var(--cyan);border:1px solid rgba(0,217,255,0.3);}

/* ══════════════ CALLOUTS ══════════════ */
.key-point,.exam-trap,.memory-trick{
border-left:4px solid;
border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;
padding:16px 20px;
margin:16px 0;
}
.key-point{
background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,217,255,0.08),rgba(15,52,96,0.3));
border-left-color:var(--cyan);
}
.exam-trap{
background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(233,69,96,0.08),rgba(231,76,60,0.1));
border-left-color:var(--coral);
}
.memory-trick{
background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(243,156,18,0.08),rgba(241,196,15,0.1));
border-left-color:var(--amber);
}
.kp-label,.et-label,.mt-label{
display:block;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:2px;
font-size:0.7rem;
font-weight:700;
margin-bottom:6px;
}
.kp-label{color:var(--cyan);}
.et-label{color:var(--coral);}
.mt-label{color:var(--amber);}
.key-point p:last-child,.exam-trap p:last-child,.memory-trick p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.key-point ul,.exam-trap ul,.memory-trick ul{margin-bottom:0;}

/* ══════════════ FORMULA BOX ══════════════ */
.formula-box{
position:relative;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(15,52,96,0.6),rgba(26,26,46,0.6));
border:1px solid var(--bg-navy);
border-radius:14px;
padding:25px 30px;
margin:18px 0;
overflow:hidden;
}
.formula-box::before{
content:"";
position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;
width:4px;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--cyan),var(--coral));
}
.formula-label{
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--muted);
font-size:0.7rem;
letter-spacing:2px;
margin-bottom:8px;
}
.formula{
font-size:1.3rem;
color:#fff;
font-family:'Courier New',monospace;
font-weight:bold;
}
.formula-desc{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.9rem;margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0;}

/* ══════════════ FORMULA GRID ══════════════ */
.formula-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:24px;}
@media (max-width:760px){.formula-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.formula-item{
background:var(--card-bg);
border-radius:12px;
padding:20px;
border:1px solid var(--card-border);
}
.fi-name{
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--muted);
font-size:0.75rem;
letter-spacing:1px;
margin-bottom:8px;
}
.fi-formula{
font-family:'Courier New',monospace;
font-size:1.1rem;
color:var(--cyan);
font-weight:bold;
}

/* ══════════════ RISK BARS ══════════════ */
.risk-bar{
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
margin-bottom:16px;
}
.risk-bar-label{width:200px;flex-shrink:0;font-size:0.84rem;color:#fff;font-weight:600;}
.risk-bar-track{
flex:1;
height:10px;
border-radius:999px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
overflow:hidden;
}
.risk-bar-fill{
height:100%;
border-radius:999px;
width:var(--w);
animation:grow-bar 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.9,0.3,1) both;
}
@keyframes grow-bar{from{width:0;}to{width:var(--w);}}
.risk-bar-fill.high{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),#ff6b6b);}
.risk-bar-fill.medium{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),var(--gold));}
.risk-bar-fill.low{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--emerald));}
@media (max-width:760px){
.risk-bar{flex-wrap:wrap;}
.risk-bar-label{width:100%;}
}

/* ══════════════ QUESTION CARDS ══════════════ */
.question-card{
position:relative;
padding-top:40px;
margin-top:34px;
}
.question-number{
position:absolute;top:-12px;left:30px;
background:var(--coral);
color:#fff;
font-weight:800;
font-size:0.75rem;
letter-spacing:2px;
padding:6px 18px;
border-radius:999px;
box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(233,69,96,0.4);
}
.question-text{font-size:1.1rem;color:#fff;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:16px;}
.answer-box{
background:rgba(46,204,113,0.1);
border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);
border-radius:10px;
padding:14px 18px;
margin-bottom:16px;
}
.ans-label{
display:block;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--emerald);
font-size:0.7rem;
letter-spacing:2px;
font-weight:700;
margin-bottom:4px;
}
.ans-text{color:#fff;font-weight:bold;}
.explanation{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:0;}
.wrong-options{border-top:1px solid var(--card-border);margin-top:15px;padding-top:15px;}
.wo-label{
display:block;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--coral);
font-size:0.7rem;
letter-spacing:2px;
font-weight:700;
margin-bottom:10px;
}
.wrong-option{
display:flex;gap:10px;
margin-bottom:10px;
font-size:0.88rem;
}
.wrong-option .x-mark{color:var(--coral);font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0;}
.wrong-option .wo-body{color:var(--muted);}
.wrong-option .wo-body strong{color:var(--text);}

/* ══════════════ CHECKLIST / MISC ══════════════ */
.checklist{list-style:none;margin-left:0;}
.checklist li{
padding-left:28px;position:relative;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:0.9rem;
}
.checklist li::before{
content:"✓";
position:absolute;left:0;
color:var(--emerald);
font-weight:800;
}
.tick{color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;}
.cross{color:var(--coral);font-weight:700;}
.tag-good{color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;}
.tag-bad{color:var(--coral);font-weight:700;}

.tip-number{
display:inline-block;
font-size:1.4rem;
margin-bottom:8px;
}
.closing-card{
text-align:center;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,217,255,0.08),rgba(233,69,96,0.08));
border:1px solid var(--card-border);
border-radius:16px;
padding:44px 28px;
margin-top:30px;
}
.closing-card h2{
background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--coral));
-webkit-background-clip:text;
background-clip:text;
-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
color:transparent;
font-size:1.8rem;
margin-bottom:10px;
}
.def-item .fi-formula{font-family:inherit;font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text);font-weight:normal;}
.def-item .fi-name{color:var(--cyan);}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CRAZY MODE — layers, effects & interactive components
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.main{position:relative;z-index:1;}
#stars{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;}
#spotlight{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:screen;
background:radial-gradient(560px circle at var(--mx,70%) var(--my,20%),rgba(0,217,255,0.07),transparent 65%);}
#scrollProgress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0;z-index:200;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--coral));box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,217,255,0.7);}
#confetti{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:400;pointer-events:none;}
::selection{background:rgba(0,217,255,0.35);color:#fff;}
body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:11px;}
body::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg-deep);}
body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:linear-gradient(var(--cyan),var(--coral));border-radius:6px;border:3px solid var(--bg-deep);}
kbd{background:#101028;border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:6px;
padding:1px 7px;font-size:0.72rem;font-family:inherit;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;}

/* reveal on scroll */
.js-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1);}
.js-reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none;}

/* hero CTA buttons */
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:28px;}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:999px;
font:inherit;font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;
color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,background .2s ease;}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),#0f8bd4);color:#04121f;border:none;box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,217,255,0.35);}
.btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,217,255,0.5);}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;border:1px dashed rgba(0,217,255,0.5);color:var(--cyan);}

/* meta card tilt */
.meta-card{transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;will-change:transform;}

/* mark-as-studied buttons */
.mark-btn{margin-top:12px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;font:inherit;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:700;
letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;border:1px dashed var(--card-border);
transition:all .25s ease;}
.mark-btn:hover{border-color:var(--emerald);color:var(--emerald);}
.mark-btn.done{background:rgba(46,204,113,0.15);border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.4);color:var(--emerald);}
.nav-link{position:relative;}
.nav-link.done::after{content:"✓";margin-left:auto;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:800;}

/* study cockpit (sidebar) */
.cockpit{padding:0 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
.cockpit-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;width:100%;
padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;font:inherit;font-size:0.8rem;cursor:pointer;
color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid var(--card-border);transition:all .2s;}
.cockpit-btn:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan);}
.ring-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--muted);}
.ring{width:44px;height:44px;flex-shrink:0;}
.ring circle{fill:none;stroke-width:4;}
.ring-bg{stroke:var(--card-border);}
.ring-fg{stroke:var(--emerald);stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:119.38;stroke-dashoffset:119.38;
transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:center;transition:stroke-dashoffset .6s ease;}
.ring-row strong{color:#fff;}
.pomo{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;}
.pomo-time{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:bold;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--cyan);}
.pomo-btns{display:flex;gap:4px;}
.pomo-btn{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:8px;font:inherit;font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
color:var(--text);background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--card-border);transition:all .2s;}
.pomo-btn:hover{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber);}
.accents{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;}
.accent-dot{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;
background:var(--dot);transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s;}
.accent-dot:hover{transform:scale(1.25);}
.accent-dot.sel{border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--dot);}

/* ══════════════ QUIZ MODE ══════════════ */
.quiz-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;
border-left:4px solid var(--coral);}
.qt-left{flex:1;min-width:220px;}
#quizScore{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--muted);}
#quizScore strong{color:var(--emerald);font-size:1.1rem;}
.qt-track{height:8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);margin-top:8px;overflow:hidden;}
.qt-fill{height:100%;width:0;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--emerald));transition:width .5s ease;}
.qt-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;}
.options{display:grid;gap:10px;margin:4px 0 16px;}
.option{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;width:100%;
background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid var(--card-border);color:var(--text);
padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.5;
transition:border-color .2s,background .2s,transform .2s;}
.option:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:rgba(0,217,255,0.55);background:rgba(0,217,255,0.06);transform:translateX(5px);}
.option:disabled{cursor:default;}
.opt-letter{flex-shrink:0;width:26px;height:26px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
border-radius:8px;font-weight:800;font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--cyan);
background:rgba(0,217,255,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,217,255,0.3);}
.option.correct{background:rgba(46,204,113,0.14);border-color:rgba(46,204,113,0.55);animation:pop .4s ease;}
.option.correct .opt-letter{color:var(--emerald);background:rgba(46,204,113,0.15);border-color:rgba(46,204,113,0.4);}
.option.wrong{background:rgba(233,69,96,0.12);border-color:rgba(233,69,96,0.55);animation:shake .45s ease;}
.option.wrong .opt-letter{color:var(--coral);background:rgba(233,69,96,0.15);border-color:rgba(233,69,96,0.4);}
.option:disabled:not(.correct):not(.wrong){opacity:0.45;}
.question-card:not(.answered):not(.revealed) .answer-box,
.question-card:not(.answered):not(.revealed) .explanation,
.question-card:not(.answered):not(.revealed) .wrong-options,
.question-card:not(.answered):not(.revealed) .key-point,
.question-card:not(.answered):not(.revealed) .exam-trap,
.question-card:not(.answered):not(.revealed) .memory-trick{display:none;}
.question-card.answered .answer-box{animation:pop .5s ease;}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.94);}60%{transform:scale(1.03);}100%{transform:scale(1);}}
@keyframes shake{10%,90%{transform:translateX(-2px);}20%,80%{transform:translateX(3px);}
30%,70%{transform:translateX(-4px);}40%,60%{transform:translateX(4px);}50%{transform:translateX(-3px);}}

/* ══════════════ FLASHCARDS ══════════════ */
.fc-tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px;}
.fc-tab{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;font:inherit;font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid var(--card-border);transition:all .2s;}
.fc-tab:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
.fc-tab.sel{color:var(--cyan);border-color:rgba(0,217,255,0.5);background:rgba(0,217,255,0.08);}
.fc-stage{perspective:1400px;display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:22px 0 14px;}
.flash-card{position:relative;width:min(540px,100%);height:280px;transform-style:preserve-3d;
transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.3,1);cursor:pointer;}
.flash-card.flipped{transform:rotateY(180deg);}
.fc-face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;border-radius:20px;
display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;
padding:30px 34px;border:1px solid var(--card-border);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);}
.fc-front{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e1e3f,#14142e);}
.fc-term{font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;}
.fc-back{transform:rotateY(180deg);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(15,52,96,0.9),#1a1a2e);}
.fc-def{font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.8;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;}
.fc-hint{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:0;right:0;font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:2px;
text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}
.flash-card.known .fc-front{border-color:rgba(46,204,113,0.5);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(46,204,113,0.15);}
.fc-meta{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:26px;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px;}
.fc-counter{color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700;}
.fc-controls{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;}
.fc-btn{padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;font:inherit;font-size:0.84rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border:1px solid var(--card-border);transition:all .2s;}
.fc-btn:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.fc-know{border-color:rgba(46,204,113,0.4);color:var(--emerald);}
.fc-know:hover{border-color:var(--emerald);color:var(--emerald);background:rgba(46,204,113,0.1);}
.fc-review{border-color:rgba(243,156,18,0.4);color:var(--amber);}
.fc-review:hover{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber);background:rgba(243,156,18,0.1);}

/* ══════════════ INTERACTIVE LAB ══════════════ */
.lab-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:0.82rem;
color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 6px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;}
.lab-label output{color:var(--cyan);font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:bold;font-size:1rem;}
input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--cyan);cursor:pointer;height:22px;}
.seat-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;margin-top:6px;}
.seat{display:inline-flex;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-size:1.05rem;
background:rgba(233,69,96,0.14);border:1px solid rgba(233,69,96,0.35);}
.seat.min{background:rgba(46,204,113,0.14);border-color:rgba(46,204,113,0.35);}
.seat.toss{background:rgba(241,196,15,0.14);border-color:rgba(241,196,15,0.35);}
.gauge{position:relative;height:12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);margin:16px 0 12px;}
.gauge-fill{height:100%;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--emerald));
transition:width .2s ease;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,217,255,0.4);}
.gauge-floor{position:absolute;top:-5px;bottom:-5px;left:33.33%;width:2px;background:var(--coral);}
.gauge-floor::after{content:"₹100 floor";position:absolute;top:-20px;left:-26px;font-size:0.62rem;
color:var(--coral);letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;}
.preset-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px;}
.dr-preset{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;font:inherit;font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;
color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(0,217,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,217,255,0.3);transition:all .2s;}
.dr-preset:hover{background:rgba(0,217,255,0.15);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.input-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.input-grid label{font-size:0.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--muted);
display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
.num-input{background:#12122a;border:1px solid var(--card-border);color:#fff;padding:10px 12px;
border-radius:10px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:1rem;font-weight:bold;width:100%;outline:none;
transition:border-color .2s;}
.num-input:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,217,255,0.12);}
.result-line{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--text);
background:rgba(15,52,96,0.35);border:1px solid var(--bg-navy);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 16px;
line-height:1.9;margin-bottom:0;}

/* ══════════════ OVERLAYS (palette + shortcuts) ══════════════ */
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(8,8,22,0.75);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);z-index:300;
display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding-top:12vh;}
.overlay.open{display:flex;}
.panel{width:min(580px,92vw);background:#15152f;border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:16px;
box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);overflow:hidden;animation:pop .25s ease;}
#palInput{width:100%;padding:17px 20px;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--card-border);
color:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:1.02rem;outline:none;}
#palList{max-height:46vh;overflow-y:auto;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:8px;}
#palList li{padding:11px 14px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);font-size:0.9rem;}
#palList li.sel{background:rgba(0,217,255,0.1);color:var(--cyan);}
#palList li.empty{color:var(--muted);cursor:default;}
.panel-foot{padding:10px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--card-border);font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--muted);}
.keys-panel h3{color:#fff;}
.keys-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:14px 18px 20px;}
.keys-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:8px 0;font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--muted);}
.keys-list li span{min-width:110px;display:inline-flex;gap:4px;}

/* ══════════════ FIXED WIDGETS ══════════════ */
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:30px;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,90px);z-index:350;max-width:88vw;
background:#15152f;border:1px solid var(--cyan);color:var(--text);padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;
font-size:0.9rem;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),0 0 20px rgba(0,217,255,0.15);
opacity:0;transition:all .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);pointer-events:none;}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0);}
#rocket{position:fixed;right:26px;bottom:26px;z-index:120;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;
font-size:1.5rem;cursor:pointer;background:#15152f;border:1px solid var(--card-border);
box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(20px);
transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s,border-color .3s;}
#rocket.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none;}
#rocket:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(0,217,255,0.35);}
#rocket.launch{animation:launch .9s ease-in forwards;}
@keyframes launch{30%{transform:translateY(6px) scale(0.95);}100%{transform:translateY(-110vh) scale(0.5);opacity:0;}}
#hamburger{display:none;position:fixed;top:16px;left:16px;z-index:210;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;
font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(15,15,35,0.9);border:1px solid var(--card-border);}
#backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55);z-index:45;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s;}
#backdrop.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}
@media (max-width:900px){
#hamburger{display:block;}
.sidebar{display:block;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1);
box-shadow:20px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
.sidebar.open{transform:none;}
}

/* konami */
body.rainbow h1,body.rainbow .brand-title{animation:hue-spin 2.5s linear infinite;}
@keyframes hue-spin{to{filter:hue-rotate(360deg);}}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:0.01ms !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important;
transition-duration:0.01ms !important;scroll-behavior:auto !important;}
}

/* ══════════════ VALUATION GUIDE EXTRAS ══════════════ */
.check-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
@media (max-width:760px){.check-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.check-item{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;
border:1px solid var(--card-border);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);cursor:pointer;
font-size:0.88rem;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;}
.check-item:hover{border-color:rgba(0,217,255,0.4);background:rgba(0,217,255,0.04);}
.check-item input{accent-color:var(--emerald);width:17px;height:17px;margin-top:3px;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer;}
.check-item input:checked ~ span{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:line-through;}
.date-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0;}
.date-chip{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:0.73rem;font-weight:700;
border:1px solid var(--card-border);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);color:var(--muted);}
.date-chip.hot{border-color:var(--coral);color:var(--coral);background:rgba(233,69,96,0.1);}
.tree{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(15,52,96,0.3);
border:1px solid var(--bg-navy);border-radius:12px;padding:18px;overflow-x:auto;
line-height:1.5;font-size:0.85rem;margin:6px 0 4px;}
pre.mono{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;background:#12122a;border:1px solid var(--card-border);
border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;overflow-x:auto;color:var(--text);font-size:0.85rem;
line-height:1.75;margin:6px 0 16px;}
.sp-mode.sel{background:rgba(0,217,255,0.18);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,217,255,0.2);}

/* ══════════════ PRINT ══════════════ */
@media print{
#stars,#spotlight,#scrollProgress,#rocket,#hamburger,#backdrop,.overlay,#toast,#confetti,
.hero-cta,.quiz-toolbar,.options,.mark-btn,.side-tools,.fc-controls,.fc-tabs{display:none !important;}
.question-card .answer-box,.question-card .explanation,.question-card .wrong-options,
.question-card .key-point,.question-card .exam-trap,.question-card .memory-trick{display:block !important;}
.js-reveal{opacity:1 !important;transform:none !important;}
:root{--text:#1a1a2e;--muted:#4a4a68;--card-bg:#ffffff;--card-border:#c9c9dd;}
body{background:#fff;color:#1a1a2e;}
.sidebar{display:none;}
.main{margin-left:0;}
.hero{background:#eef1f8;color:#1a1a2e;}
h1{-webkit-text-fill-color:#0f0f23;color:#0f0f23;background:none;}
h2,h3,.question-text,.ans-text,strong,td .cell-title{color:#0f0f23;}
.card,.mini-card,.formula-item{box-shadow:none;background:#fff;border-color:#c9c9dd;break-inside:avoid;}
.card:hover{transform:none;animation:none;}
.comparison-table td,.summary-table td{background:#fff;color:#1a1a2e;}
.comparison-table th{background:#dfe7f5;color:#0f3460;}
.summary-table th{background:#e8e8f5;color:#0f0f23;}
.formula,.fi-formula{color:#0f3460;}
.formula-box{background:#f2f5fb;}
.meta-card{background:#fff;border-color:#c9c9dd;color:#1a1a2e;}
.meta-card .mc-value{color:#0f0f23;}
.explanation,.wo-body,.formula-desc,.cell-sub,.hero-sub{color:#4a4a68;}
}

/* ══════════════ MASTER GUIDE — utility subset ══════════════ */
.lucide{font-style:normal;display:inline-block;line-height:1;}
.flex{display:flex}.grid{display:grid}.flex-wrap{flex-wrap:wrap}
.items-center{align-items:center}.items-start{align-items:flex-start}
.justify-between{justify-content:space-between}.justify-center{justify-content:center}
.gap-2{gap:.5rem}.gap-3{gap:.75rem}.gap-4{gap:1rem}.gap-5{gap:1.25rem}
.grid-cols-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.grid-cols-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.col-span-2{grid-column:span 2/span 2}
.p-2{padding:.5rem}.p-3{padding:.75rem}.p-4{padding:1rem}.p-5{padding:1.25rem}.p-6{padding:1.5rem}
.py-1{padding-top:.25rem;padding-bottom:.25rem}
.mb-1{margin-bottom:.25rem}.mb-2{margin-bottom:.5rem}.mb-3{margin-bottom:.75rem}.mb-4{margin-bottom:1rem}.mb-5{margin-bottom:1.25rem}.mb-12{margin-bottom:3rem}
.mt-1{margin-top:.25rem}.mt-1\.5{margin-top:.375rem}.mt-2{margin-top:.5rem}.mt-3{margin-top:.75rem}.mt-4{margin-top:1rem}.mt-5{margin-top:1.25rem}.mt-6{margin-top:1.5rem}
.ml-1{margin-left:.25rem}.ml-2{margin-left:.5rem}.mx-auto{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.w-4{width:1rem}.w-5{width:1.25rem}.w-11{width:2.75rem}.w-full{width:100%}
.h-4{height:1rem}.h-5{height:1.25rem}.h-11{height:2.75rem}
.space-y-0\.5>*+*{margin-top:.125rem}.space-y-1>*+*{margin-top:.25rem}.space-y-1\.5>*+*{margin-top:.375rem}
.space-y-2>*+*{margin-top:.5rem}.space-y-3>*+*{margin-top:.75rem}
.text-xs{font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.5}.text-sm{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.6}.text-base{font-size:1rem}
.text-lg{font-size:1.125rem}.text-2xl{font-size:1.5rem}.text-3xl{font-size:1.875rem}
.text-\[10px\]{font-size:10px}.text-\[11px\]{font-size:11px}
.font-bold{font-weight:700}.font-semibold{font-weight:600}.font-black{font-weight:900}
.font-mono{font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
.uppercase{text-transform:uppercase}.tracking-wider{letter-spacing:.05em}.tracking-widest{letter-spacing:.1em}
.text-center{text-align:center}.text-left{text-align:left}
.overflow-x-auto{overflow-x:auto}
.rounded-lg{border-radius:.5rem}.rounded-xl{border-radius:.75rem}
.border{border:1px solid var(--card-border)}.border-t{border-top:1px solid var(--card-border)}
.text-white{color:#fff}
.text-slate-300{color:#c3cbe0}.text-slate-400{color:#9aa6c0}.text-slate-500{color:#7c88a3}
.text-emerald-300{color:#6ee7b7}.text-emerald-400{color:#2ecc71}
.text-cyan-300{color:#7be6ff}.text-cyan-400{color:var(--cyan)}
.text-violet-300{color:#c4b5fd}.text-violet-400{color:#a78bfa}
.text-rose-300{color:#fda4af}.text-rose-400{color:#e94560}
.text-amber-300{color:#fcd34d}.text-amber-400{color:#f39c12}
.bg-emerald-500\/5{background-color:rgba(46,204,113,.05)}
.bg-cyan-500\/5{background-color:rgba(0,217,255,.05)}
.bg-rose-500\/5{background-color:rgba(233,69,96,.05)}
.\!bg-rose-500\/5{background-color:rgba(233,69,96,.07)!important}
.border-emerald-500\/20{border-color:rgba(46,204,113,.2)}.border-emerald-500\/30{border-color:rgba(46,204,113,.3)}
.border-cyan-500\/20{border-color:rgba(0,217,255,.2)}.border-cyan-500\/30{border-color:rgba(0,217,255,.3)}
.border-rose-500\/20{border-color:rgba(233,69,96,.2)}.\!border-rose-500\/40{border-color:rgba(233,69,96,.4)!important}
.border-violet-500\/30{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,.3)}.border-white\/10{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.bg-gradient-to-br{background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom right,var(--twf,transparent),var(--twt,transparent))}
.from-emerald-500\/20{--twf:rgba(46,204,113,.2)}.from-cyan-500\/20{--twf:rgba(0,217,255,.2)}
.from-violet-500\/20{--twf:rgba(167,139,250,.2)}.from-rose-500\/20{--twf:rgba(233,69,96,.2)}
.from-amber-500\/10{--twf:rgba(243,156,18,.1)}
.to-cyan-500\/10{--twt:rgba(0,217,255,.1)}.to-violet-500\/10{--twt:rgba(167,139,250,.1)}
.to-emerald-500\/10{--twt:rgba(46,204,113,.1)}.to-amber-500\/10{--twt:rgba(243,156,18,.1)}
@media(min-width:768px){
.md\:grid-cols-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.md\:grid-cols-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.md\:grid-cols-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.md\:col-span-2{grid-column:span 2/span 2}
.md\:p-8{padding:2rem}
}
@media(min-width:1024px){.lg\:grid-cols-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}

/* ══════════════ component adapter (Midnight Scholar skin) ══════════════ */
.section-anchor{scroll-margin-top:24px}
.section-title{font-size:1.45rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;line-height:1.3}
.sub-title{font-size:1.02rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.glass{background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.glass-2{background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:12px}
.icon-tile{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:12px}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;background:rgba(0,217,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,217,255,.3);color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none}
.keyword{color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700}
.hl{background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(0,217,255,.28),rgba(0,217,255,.1));padding:0 4px;border-radius:4px;color:#fff}
.b-em{color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700}.b-cy{color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700}.b-amb{color:var(--amber);font-weight:700}
.warning{border-left:4px solid var(--amber);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(243,156,18,.08),rgba(241,196,15,.06));border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;padding:12px 16px}
.danger{border-left:4px solid var(--coral);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(233,69,96,.08),rgba(231,76,60,.06));border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;padding:12px 16px}
.quote{border-left:4px solid var(--cyan);background:rgba(0,217,255,.06);border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;padding:12px 16px;font-style:italic}
.ann{color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}
.arrow-li{position:relative;padding-left:20px;list-style:none}
.arrow-li::before{content:"→";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700}
.check-li{position:relative;padding-left:20px;list-style:none}
.check-li::before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:800}
.x-li{position:relative;padding-left:20px;list-style:none}
.x-li::before{content:"✗";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--coral);font-weight:800}
.num{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:700;color:var(--cyan)}
.step-num{display:inline-flex;width:26px;height:26px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(0,217,255,.12);color:var(--cyan);font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;border:1px solid rgba(0,217,255,.3);flex-shrink:0}
.chev{color:var(--cyan)}
.ring-em{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(46,204,113,.35)}
.card-hover{transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
.card-hover:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
table.pretty{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;min-width:480px}
table.pretty th{background:var(--bg-navy);color:var(--cyan);padding:10px 14px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:.68rem;text-align:left}
table.pretty td{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--card-border);background:rgba(30,30,63,.5);font-size:.86rem;vertical-align:top}
table.pretty tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
table.pretty tbody tr:hover td{background:rgba(0,217,255,.05)}
.calc-result{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(15,52,96,.6),rgba(26,26,46,.6));border:1px solid var(--bg-navy);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px}
.tab-btn{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font:inherit;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--card-border);transition:all .2s}
.tab-btn:hover{color:var(--cyan)}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--cyan);border-color:rgba(0,217,255,.5);background:rgba(0,217,255,.08)}
.tex{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;color:#dfe8ff;display:block;text-align:center;padding:6px 4px;font-size:1.02em;line-height:1.9}
.frac{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;vertical-align:middle;margin:0 5px;line-height:1.4}
.frac>span{padding:0 7px}
.frac>span:first-child{border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(223,232,255,.7)}
.formula-box .tex{padding:2px 4px}
details{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:12px;padding:0 16px;margin-bottom:10px;transition:border-color .2s}
details:hover{border-color:rgba(0,217,255,.35)}
details summary{cursor:pointer;padding:13px 0;font-weight:600;color:#fff;list-style:none;outline:none}
details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details summary::before{content:"▸";margin-right:10px;color:var(--cyan);display:inline-block;transition:transform .25s}
details[open] summary::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
details>*:not(summary){margin-bottom:14px}
.master-section .mark-btn{margin:0 0 0 auto;align-self:center}

<section id="ch1" class="section-anchor mb-12">
<div class="section-head flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
<div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500/20 to-cyan-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-emerald-300">01</div>
<div>
<div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold">Chapter 1 · Foundations</div>
<h2 class="section-title text-white">Overview of Equity Securities</h2>
</div>
</div>

<!-- LOS A: Types of Equity Securities -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
<span class="badge b-em">LOS A</span><h3 class="sub-title">Types of Equity Securities</h3>
</div>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-5">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"><span class="lucide">👑</span><h4 class="font-bold text-white">1. Common Shares (Equity)</h4></div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-3">Common shareholders are the <span class="keyword">REAL OWNERS</span> of the company.</p>
<ul class="text-sm space-y-1">
<li class="check-li"><span><span class="hl">Residual Claim</span> — paid LAST, after debt and preference holders.</span></li>
<li class="check-li"><span><span class="hl">Voting Power</span> — appoint the Board of Directors.</span></li>
<li class="check-li"><span>Returns = <span class="keyword">Dividends</span> (not mandatory) + <span class="keyword">Capital Appreciation</span>.</span></li>
<li class="check-li"><span><span class="danger">HIGHEST RISK</span> equity security.</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"><span class="lucide">🛡️</span><h4 class="font-bold text-white">2. Preference Shares (Preferred Stock)</h4></div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-3">"Preference" over common shares in two ways:</p>
<ul class="text-sm space-y-1">
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b class="text-white">Liquidation Preference</b> — paid before common shareholders.</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b class="text-white">Fixed Dividend</b> — e.g., 8% of ₹100 = ₹8.</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Dividends paid only out of <span class="warning">PROFITS</span>.</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Generally <span class="danger">NO voting rights</span>.</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<h4 class="sub-title mb-3 mt-6">Sub-Types of Preference Shares</h4>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">A. Cumulative vs Non-Cumulative</div>
<table class="pretty mb-2">
<thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th class="text-emerald-300">Cumulative</th><th class="text-rose-300">Non-Cumulative</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Missed Dividends</td><td>Accumulated, paid later</td><td>Lost forever</td></tr>
<tr><td>Risk Level</td><td><span class="hl">Less Risky</span></td><td><span class="danger">More Risky</span></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-400"><b>Example:</b> Promised ₹8, only ₹7 profit available → cumulative: ₹1 paid later; non-cumulative: ₹1 lost forever.</p>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">B. Participating vs Non-Participating</div>
<table class="pretty mb-2">
<thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th class="text-emerald-300">Participating</th><th class="text-rose-300">Non-Participating</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Extra Dividend</td><td>Yes (if profits exceed threshold)</td><td>No (fixed only)</td></tr>
<tr><td>Risk Level</td><td><span class="hl">Less Risky</span></td><td><span class="danger">More Risky</span></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-400"><b>Example:</b> Fixed = ₹8. If profits boom, participating may get ₹10–₹12.</p>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">C. Convertible Preference Shares</div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">Can be <span class="keyword">converted into common equity</span> at investor's option using a <b>Conversion Ratio</b>.</p>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-400 space-y-1">
<li class="arrow-li"><span>If market price &gt; redemption → <span class="keyword">CONVERT</span></span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>If market price ≤ redemption → <span class="keyword">TAKE CASH</span></span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><span class="hl">LESS RISKY</span> — investor has the option (right, not obligation).</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">D. Callable vs Puttable</div>
<table class="pretty mb-2">
<thead><tr><th></th><th class="text-rose-300">Callable</th><th class="text-emerald-300">Puttable</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Right Holder</td><td><b>Company</b> ("C for C")</td><td><b>Investor</b></td></tr>
<tr><td>Action</td><td>Buy back at Call Price</td><td>Sell back at Put Price</td></tr>
<tr><td>Investor Impact</td><td>Capital gain <span class="danger">CAPPED</span></td><td>Capital loss <span class="hl">LIMITED</span></td></tr>
<tr><td>Risk</td><td><span class="danger">More Risky</span></td><td><span class="hl">Less Risky</span></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-400"><b>Callable example:</b> FV ₹100, Call ₹102 → max gain ₹2 (even if market hits ₹110, called at ₹102).</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5 mt-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-3">Risk Hierarchy (Highest → Lowest)</div>
<div class="space-y-2">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#1</span><span class="text-sm text-rose-300 font-semibold">Common Shares</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Residual claim, no guaranteed dividend</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#2</span><span class="text-sm">Non-Participating Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">No upside potential</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#3</span><span class="text-sm">Non-Cumulative Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Missed dividends lost</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#4</span><span class="text-sm">Callable Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Gain capped by company</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#5</span><span class="text-sm">General Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Fixed dividend, priority</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#6</span><span class="text-sm">Participating Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Extra dividend potential</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#7</span><span class="text-sm">Cumulative Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Missed dividends accumulated</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#8</span><span class="text-sm">Puttable Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Loss limited</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span class="ann">#9</span><span class="text-sm text-emerald-300 font-semibold">Convertible Preference</span><span class="text-xs text-slate-500">Lowest — option to convert</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- LOS B: Voting -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">LOS B</span><h3 class="sub-title">Voting Power — Statutory vs Cumulative</h3></div>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<h4 class="font-bold text-white mb-2">1. Statutory (Straight) Voting</h4>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-3">Each share = 1 vote per director seat. Majority controls everything.</p>
<div class="bg-rose-500/5 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs">
<div class="font-bold text-rose-300 mb-1">Example: Jio (3 seats A, B, C)</div>
<div class="text-slate-400">Ambani 60% → 60–60–0 votes<br/>Vikas 40% → 0–0–40 votes<br/><b class="text-white">Result:</b> A✓(60%), B✓(60%), C✗(40%)</div>
<div class="text-rose-300 mt-1.5">⚠ Minority gets ZERO board representation despite 40% ownership.</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<h4 class="font-bold text-white mb-2">2. Cumulative Voting <span class="badge b-em ml-1">Good Governance</span></h4>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-3">Total votes = Ownership% × seats. Can pool all votes onto one candidate.</p>
<div class="bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs">
<div class="font-bold text-emerald-300 mb-1">Same Example with Cumulative</div>
<div class="text-slate-400">Ambani 180% total → 90–90–0<br/>Vikas 120% total → 0–0–120<br/><b class="text-white">Result:</b> A✓, B✓, C✓ — all elected</div>
<div class="text-emerald-300 mt-1.5">✓ Minority gets proportional board seat representation.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- LOS C: Dual Class -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">LOS C</span><h3 class="sub-title">Dual Class Equity Structures</h3></div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-3">Different classes of equity shares with <span class="keyword">different voting rights</span>. Examples: Tata Motors & Tata Motors DVR, Facebook (Meta), Alphabet (Google).</p>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-2">How Dual Class Works (Zuckerberg Example)</div>
<ul class="text-sm space-y-1">
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Zuckerberg invests ₹60 (30% capital) | Public invests ₹140 (70% capital)</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b>Without dual class:</b> Zuckerberg gets only 30% votes → loses control</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b>With dual class:</b> Class 1 with super-voting rights → Zuckerberg gets 60% voting with only 30% capital</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5 ring-em">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"><span class="lucide">⚠️</span><div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-amber-400">Governance Assessment</div></div>
<div class="text-2xl font-black text-rose-300 mb-1">BAD GOVERNANCE</div>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1 mt-2">
<li class="x-li"><span>Promoters control with LESS capital invested</span></li>
<li class="x-li"><span>Disproportionate voting power vs economic ownership</span></li>
<li class="x-li"><span>Minority shareholders have limited say despite higher contribution</span></li>
<li class="x-li"><span>Management accountability is reduced</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- LOS D: Public vs Private -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">LOS D</span><h3 class="sub-title">Public vs Private Equity</h3></div>
<table class="pretty">
<thead><tr><th>Aspect</th><th class="text-cyan-300">Public Equity (Reliance, TCS)</th><th class="text-violet-300">Private Equity (Startups)</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><b class="text-white">Liquidity</b></td><td>HIGH — easy to buy/sell</td><td>LOW — illiquid</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-white">Governance</b></td><td>STRONG — strict SEBI compliance</td><td>WEAKER — less oversight</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-white">Disclosure</b></td><td>HIGH — regular reporting, audits</td><td>LOWER — minimal requirements</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-white">Reporting Cost</b></td><td>HIGH — audits, AGM, reports</td><td>LOWER — no audit/AGM costs</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-white">Short-term Pressure</b></td><td>HIGH — quarterly results matter</td><td>LOW — no stock market pressure</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-white">Focus</b></td><td>Short-term profitability</td><td>Long-term goals</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-white">Growth Potential</b></td><td>Lower</td><td>HIGHER</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="quote mt-4 text-sm">
<b class="text-white">Real example:</b> TCS/Infosys didn't invest heavily in AI because it would reduce short-term ROE and stock price — they missed the AI trend. TCS dropped from ₹4,500 to ₹2,200. <span class="text-emerald-300">Public equity short-term pressure has a real cost.</span>
</div>
</div>

<!-- LOS E: ADR/GDR -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">LOS E</span><h3 class="sub-title">Foreign Equity Investments — ADR, GDR, Global Registered Shares</h3></div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5 mb-4">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-amber-400 mb-2">Why Foreign Investors Hesitate to Invest in India</div>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
<div class="text-sm"><b class="text-white">1. Weak Governance</b><br/><span class="text-slate-400">SEBI framework weaker than US/UK; fear of manipulation; weak enforcement.</span></div>
<div class="text-sm"><b class="text-white">2. Currency (Rupee) Risk</b><br/><span class="text-slate-400">Even 5% INR gain can become a USD loss if rupee depreciates. Example: ₹100→₹105 but $1: ₹100→₹117 ⇒ USD return = NEGATIVE.</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5 card-hover">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-1">ADR</div>
<div class="text-base font-bold text-white mb-2">American Depository Receipt</div>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Listed on <b>US markets</b></span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Trades in <b>USD</b></span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Must follow <b>SEC / US GAAP</b></span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Examples: HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Infosys, Wipro</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Represents MULTIPLE shares (e.g. 3 shares = 1 ADR @ $23.54 → $7.85/share ≈ ₹746)</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5 card-hover">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-1">GDR</div>
<div class="text-base font-bold text-white mb-2">Global Depository Receipt</div>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Listed <b>OUTSIDE US</b> (London, Luxembourg)</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b>Currency still USD</b> (not GBP!)</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Multiple shares clubbed</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Example: Reliance GDR on London Stock Exchange</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5 card-hover">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-violet-400 mb-1">GRS</div>
<div class="text-base font-bold text-white mb-2">Global Registered Shares</div>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Listed on <b>MULTIPLE exchanges</b> simultaneously</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Purpose: <b>Visibility</b>, NOT raising capital</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Companies are already large: Meta, Alphabet, Amazon</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span>Like listing on both 99acres + MagicBricks</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="mt-5">
<h4 class="sub-title mb-3">Sponsored vs Unsponsored ADR/GDR</h4>
<table class="pretty">
<thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th class="text-emerald-300">Sponsored</th><th class="text-cyan-300">Unsponsored</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Direct Public Sale</td><td>Yes</td><td>No — via Depository Bank</td></tr>
<tr><td>Rules & Regulations</td><td>More</td><td>Less</td></tr>
<tr><td>Voting Power</td><td>Public</td><td>Depository Bank</td></tr>
<tr><td>Speed</td><td>Slower</td><td>Faster</td></tr>
<tr><td>Company–Public Link</td><td>Yes (direct)</td><td>No</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2"><b>Indian practice:</b> Most companies (e.g., Tata Motors via Citibank) use the <span class="keyword">UNSPONSORED</span> route — faster & lower compliance.</p>
</div>
</div>

<!-- LOS G, H: Book Value, ROE -->
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-5">
<div class="glass p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"><span class="badge b-em">LOS G</span><h3 class="sub-title">Book Value vs Market Value</h3></div>
<div class="text-sm text-slate-300 space-y-2">
<p><b class="text-white">Market Value:</b> Price at which a stock is currently traded. (HDFC Bank @ ₹750)</p>
<p><b class="text-white">Book Value:</b> Total money invested by owners + reinvested profits.</p>
</div>
<div class="formula-box mt-3">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-1">FORMULA</div>
<span class="tex">Book Value = Equity Share Capital + Retained Earnings</span>
<span class="tex">P/B Ratio = <span class="frac"><span>Market Price per Share</span><span>Book Value per Share</span></span></span>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-3 mt-3 text-xs">
<b class="text-cyan-300">HDFC Bank Example:</b> Price ₹750.50, BV ₹363.59 → P/B = <span class="num">2.07</span><br/>
<span class="text-slate-400">For every ₹1 invested by owners, market pays ₹2.07. Banking stocks typically trade at P/B of 2–3.</span>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"><span class="badge b-em">LOS H</span><h3 class="sub-title">ROE vs Required Rate of Return</h3></div>
<div class="text-sm text-slate-300 space-y-2">
<p><b class="text-white">Required Rate of Return:</b> Minimum return investor expects. Always <span class="keyword">positive</span> (Nifty ~12%).</p>
<p><b class="text-white">ROE:</b> Actual return earned by company. Can be <span class="warning">positive OR negative</span>.</p>
</div>
<div class="formula-box mt-3">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-1">FORMULA</div>
<span class="tex">ROE = <span class="frac"><span>Net Income</span><span>Average Book Value</span></span></span>
<span class="tex">Avg BV = <span class="frac"><span>Opening BV + Closing BV</span><span>2</span></span></span>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-3 mt-3 text-xs">
<b class="text-emerald-300">Decision Rule:</b> ROE ≥ Required Return → INVEST<br/>
<b class="text-emerald-300">ROE rising is POSITIVE when:</b> Net Income rises FASTER than Book Value.<br/>
<span class="text-slate-400">Year 1: Capital ₹100, Profit ₹20 (20%). Year 2: Capital ₹120, Profit ₹30 (25%) → ROE improved ✓</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- LOS I: Role of Equity Financing -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">LOS I</span><h3 class="sub-title">Role of Equity in Financing — Uses of Equity Capital</h3></div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center"><div class="icon-tile mx-auto mb-2"><span class="lucide">🏢</span></div><div class="text-sm font-bold text-white">1. Productive Assets</div><div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">Land, plant, machinery (CapEx)</div></div>
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center"><div class="icon-tile mx-auto mb-2"><span class="lucide">📈</span></div><div class="text-sm font-bold text-white">2. Investments</div><div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">MFs, FDs, other companies</div></div>
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center"><div class="icon-tile mx-auto mb-2"><span class="lucide">📦</span></div><div class="text-sm font-bold text-white">3. Working Capital</div><div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">Inventory, raw materials</div></div>
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center"><div class="icon-tile mx-auto mb-2"><span class="lucide">🧾</span></div><div class="text-sm font-bold text-white">4. Expenses</div><div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">Operating, admin, salaries</div></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="ch2" class="section-anchor mb-12">
<div class="section-head flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
<div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500/20 to-cyan-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-emerald-300">02</div>
<div>
<div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold">Chapter 2 · Valuation Foundations</div>
<h2 class="section-title text-white">Equity Valuation — Concepts & Methods</h2>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Market vs Intrinsic Value -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">Concept A</span><h3 class="sub-title">Market Price vs Intrinsic (Fair) Value</h3></div>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-1">Current Market Price (CMP)</div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300">The price at which the share is currently being bought/sold in the market.</p>
<div class="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">Example: <span class="hl">Reliance @ ₹1,300</span></div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-violet-400 mb-1">Intrinsic / Fair Value</div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300">The TRUE value of a stock per an analyst's calculation/model. <span class="keyword">Analyst-specific</span>.</p>
<div class="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">Analyst A: ₹1,500 | Analyst B: ₹1,200 (Jefferies vs JP Morgan)</div>
</div>
</div>

<table class="pretty mb-4">
<thead><tr><th>Scenario</th><th>Condition</th><th>Action</th><th>Remark</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><b class="text-emerald-300">UNDERVALUED</b></td><td>FV (₹1,500) &gt; CMP (₹1,300)</td><td><span class="hl">BUY</span></td><td>Cheap; will rise to fair value</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-cyan-300">FAIRLY VALUED</b></td><td>FV = CMP</td><td>HOLD</td><td>No mispricing</td></tr>
<tr><td><b class="text-rose-300">OVERVALUED</b></td><td>FV (₹1,200) &lt; CMP (₹1,300)</td><td><span class="danger">DO NOT BUY / SELL</span></td><td>Expensive; will fall</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<div class="glass-2 p-4">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-amber-400 mb-2">Three Conditions to Profit from Valuation</div>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
<div class="text-sm"><span class="step-num">1</span> <b class="text-white ml-1">Mispricing must exist</b><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Market price ≠ intrinsic value</div></div>
<div class="text-sm"><span class="step-num">2</span> <b class="text-white ml-1">Followed by FEW analysts</b><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Mispricing more likely; many analysts = efficient</div></div>
<div class="text-sm"><span class="step-num">3</span> <b class="text-white ml-1">Price must CONVERGE</b><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Market must eventually recognize true value</div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Methods of Equity Valuation -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">Concept B</span><h3 class="sub-title">Methods of Equity Valuation</h3></div>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5 card-hover">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"><span class="lucide">⚖️</span><h4 class="font-bold text-white">1. Relative Valuation</h4></div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">Compares with similar listed companies using <b>multiples</b>.</p>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400">
<b class="text-cyan-300">Property analogy:</b> Similar 250 sq.yd. plot sold for ₹2 crore → yours is also ₹2 crore.<br/>
<b class="text-cyan-300">Equity example:</b> HDFC P/E = 17x. ICICI EPS = ₹10 → Fair Value ICICI = 10 × 17 = <span class="num">₹170</span>
</div>
<div class="mt-2 text-xs"><span class="badge b-em">When to use</span> Comparables exist; mature industries (banking, FMCG).</div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5 card-hover">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"><span class="lucide">📊</span><h4 class="font-bold text-white">2. Absolute Valuation</h4></div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">Values a company on its own merits.</p>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
<div><b class="text-emerald-300">A. NAV:</b> For distressed companies, asset-focused</div>
<div><b class="text-emerald-300">B. DCF:</b> Forecast future cash flows, discount to PV</div>
<div class="text-slate-400">&nbsp;&nbsp;• <b>DDM</b> — for dividend-paying (ITC, Infosys, PFC, REC)</div>
<div class="text-slate-400">&nbsp;&nbsp;• <b>FCFE</b> — for non-dividend payers (Reliance, Zomato, PW)</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h4 class="sub-title mb-3">When to Use NAV vs DCF (Real Examples)</h4>
<table class="pretty">
<thead><tr><th>Aspect</th><th class="text-emerald-300">DCF</th><th class="text-violet-300">NAV</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>When to Use</td><td>Healthy company, no comparable</td><td>Financial distress</td></tr>
<tr><td>Focus</td><td>Future cash flows / profits</td><td>Current tangible assets</td></tr>
<tr><td>Interest in...</td><td>The BUSINESS</td><td>The ASSETS</td></tr>
<tr><td>Examples</td><td>Physics Wallah, Zomato, new-age startups</td><td>Reliance Communications (spectrum), Jet Airways (aircraft)</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="quote mt-3 text-sm">"We are NOT interested in your BUSINESS. We are MORE interested in your ASSETS." — NAV logic (Aggarwal Sweets / Jet Airways acquisitions)</div>
</div>

<!-- Dividends & Corporate Actions -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">Concept C</span><h3 class="sub-title">Types of Dividends & Corporate Actions</h3></div>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<h4 class="font-bold text-white mb-2">1. Regular Cash Dividend <span class="badge b-em ml-1">Sticky</span></h4>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">Periodic dividends from profits — STICKY in nature (if paid today, likely to continue).</p>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400"><b>Examples:</b> ITC, TCS, Infosys, PFC, REC, Coal India, NTPC</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1"><b>Analogy:</b> ₹100/month pocket money — expected to continue.</div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<h4 class="font-bold text-white mb-2">2. Special Dividend <span class="badge b-amb ml-1">One-time</span></h4>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">One-time, non-recurring dividend due to extraordinary profits. <span class="warning">NOT sticky</span>.</p>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400"><b>Triggers:</b> Sale of division (ITC Hotels demerger), windfall gains, exceptional year</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1"><b>Analogy:</b> Diwali ₹1,000 (vs regular ₹100) — one-time reward.</div>
</div>
</div>

<h4 class="sub-title mb-3">Stock Split, Bonus Shares, Reverse Split — Essentially the Same Concept</h4>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">3. Stock Split / Bonus Shares</div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">Divide one share into multiple → price drops, count rises, <span class="keyword">net worth unchanged</span>.</p>
<div class="bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs">
<b class="text-emerald-300">MRF Example (10:1 split):</b><br/>
Before: 1 share × ₹1,25,000 = ₹1,25,000<br/>
After: 10 shares × ₹12,500 = <span class="num">₹1,25,000</span> ✓
</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2"><b>Purpose:</b> Improve liquidity. Reliance does bonus issues; <span class="warning">Berkshire never splits</span> (Buffett wants exclusivity).</div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-rose-400 mb-2">4. Reverse Stock Split</div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">Combine multiple shares into one → price rises, count drops, <span class="keyword">net worth unchanged</span>.</p>
<div class="bg-rose-500/5 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs">
<b class="text-rose-300">Vodafone Example (10:1 reverse):</b><br/>
Before: 10 shares × ₹15 = ₹150<br/>
After: 1 share × ₹150 = <span class="num">₹150</span> ✓
</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2"><b>Done by:</b> Weak/poorly performing companies to lift price.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5 mt-4">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-2">5. Share Repurchase / Buyback</div>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-300 mb-2">Company buys back its own shares at a <span class="keyword">premium</span> to market price — tax-efficient alternative to dividends.</p>
<div class="bg-cyan-500/5 border border-cyan-500/20 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs">
<b class="text-cyan-300">TCS Example:</b> Market Price ₹3,800, Buyback ₹4,500 → Shareholder gets extra ₹700 (like dividend, lower tax).
</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2">Reduces outstanding shares → EPS improves.</div>
</div>

<h4 class="sub-title mb-3 mt-5">Summary — Corporate Action Effects</h4>
<table class="pretty">
<thead><tr><th>Action</th><th>Price</th><th>Shares</th><th>Net Worth</th><th>Purpose</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Regular Dividend</td><td>No direct effect</td><td>No change</td><td>↑ Cash</td><td>Reward shareholders</td></tr>
<tr><td>Special Dividend</td><td>No direct effect</td><td>No change</td><td>↑ Cash (1x)</td><td>Extraordinary profits</td></tr>
<tr><td>Stock Split / Bonus</td><td>↓ Decreases</td><td>↑ Increases</td><td>No change</td><td>Improve liquidity</td></tr>
<tr><td>Reverse Split</td><td>↑ Increases</td><td>↓ Decreases</td><td>No change</td><td>Boost perceived value</td></tr>
<tr><td>Share Buyback</td><td>No direct effect</td><td>↓ Decreases</td><td>↑ Cash (premium)</td><td>Tax-efficient reward</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<!-- Dividend Chronology -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">Concept D</span><h3 class="sub-title">Dividend Payment Chronology — Timeline</h3></div>

<div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-1">June 3</div>
<div class="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">Declaration Date</div>
<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">COMPANY</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2">Announces ₹10/share dividend. NO money paid yet.</div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-400 font-bold mb-1">June 15</div>
<div class="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">Ex-Dividend Date</div>
<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">LAW</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2">First day buyer does NOT get dividend. Price drops by dividend amount.</div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-violet-400 font-bold mb-1">June 16</div>
<div class="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">Holder of Record</div>
<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">COMPANY</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2">"Snapshot" of shareholders — they get paid.</div>
</div>
<div class="glass-2 p-4 text-center">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-400 font-bold mb-1">June 24</div>
<div class="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">Payment Date</div>
<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">LAW</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2">Within 21 working days. Cash credited.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-4">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">Mnemonic & Mechanics</div>
<div class="text-sm text-slate-300">Sequence: <span class="hl">COMPANY → LAW → COMPANY → LAW</span></div>
<div class="formula-box mt-2">
<span class="tex">Ex-Dividend Date = Holder of Record Date - 1 Business Day</span>
</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2"><b>Settlement India: T+2.</b> Buy on June 14 → settle June 16 → get dividend. Buy June 15 → settle June 17 → no dividend.</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1"><b>Price impact:</b> Before Ex-Date: ₹300 (incl. div). On Ex-Date: ₹290 (drops by ₹10).</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- DCF Numericals -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">Concept E</span><h3 class="sub-title">Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) — Numericals</h3></div>

<div class="formula-box mb-4">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-1">DCF FORMULA</div>
<span class="tex">PV = <span class="frac"><span>CF<sub>1</sub></span><span>(1+r)<sup>1</sup></span></span> + <span class="frac"><span>CF<sub>2</sub></span><span>(1+r)<sup>2</sup></span></span> + … + <span class="frac"><span>CF<sub>n</sub></span><span>(1+r)<sup>n</sup></span></span></span>
</div>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-2">Numerical 1 — Single Period</div>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-0.5 mb-2">
<li>• Last dividend: $1.00, next +5%</li>
<li>• Sell price after 1 year: $13.45</li>
<li>• Required rate: 13.2%</li>
</ul>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 space-y-1">
<div><b class="text-white">Year 1 CF:</b> $1.05 (div) + $13.45 (sale) = $14.50</div>
<div><b class="text-white">PV:</b> 14.50 / 1.132 = <span class="num">$12.81</span></div>
</div>
<div class="calc-result mt-2 text-xs"><b class="text-emerald-300">Answer:</b> Pay max <span class="num">$12.81</span> today.</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-2">Numerical 2 — Multi Period</div>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-0.5 mb-2">
<li>• Dividend $1.50, growing 8% / year</li>
<li>• Sell after 3 years for $51</li>
<li>• Required rate: 12%</li>
</ul>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 space-y-1">
<div><b class="text-white">D1:</b> $1.62 | <b class="text-white">D2:</b> $1.7496 | <b class="text-white">D3:</b> $1.8896</div>
<div><b class="text-white">Y3 total:</b> $1.8896 + $51 = $52.8896</div>
<div>PV1=$1.4464 | PV2=$1.3948 | PV3=$37.6370</div>
</div>
<div class="calc-result mt-2 text-xs"><b class="text-emerald-300">Answer:</b> Fair value today = <span class="num">$40.48</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-4 mt-4">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-amber-400 mb-2">BA II Plus Calculator — Cash Flow Function</div>
<div class="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-300 space-y-0.5">
<div>1. CF → 2nd → CLR WORK</div>
<div>2. CF0 = 0 ↓↓ | C01 = 1.62 ↓↓ | C02 = 1.7496 ↓↓ | C03 = 52.8896 ↵</div>
<div>3. NPV → I = 12 ↓ → CPT → <span class="text-emerald-300 font-bold">40.48</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="ch3" class="section-anchor mb-12">
<div class="section-head flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
<div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500/20 to-cyan-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-emerald-300">03</div>
<div>
<div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold">Chapter 3 · DDM Family</div>
<h2 class="section-title text-white">Dividend Discount Models (Single & Multi-Stage)</h2>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Gordon Growth -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">Single-Stage</span><h3 class="sub-title">The Gordon Growth Model</h3></div>

<div class="formula-box mb-4">
<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-1">GORDON GROWTH FORMULA</div>
<span class="tex">P<sub>0</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>D<sub>1</sub></span><span>r - g</span></span></span>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2"><b>P₀</b> = intrinsic value today | <b>D₁</b> = dividend at end of Year 1 | <b>r</b> = required return | <b>g</b> = constant growth (forever)</div>
<div class="text-xs text-amber-300 mt-1.5 font-semibold">⚠ Critical: r MUST be &gt; g, else formula breaks down.</div>
</div>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-2">Derivation via Geometric Progression</div>
<ul class="text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1 mb-2">
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b>Arithmetic:</b> 2, 4, 6, 8...</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b>Geometric:</b> 2, 4, 8, 16... (multiplier)</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b>Increasing GP:</b> Cannot sum to infinity</span></li>
<li class="arrow-li"><span><b>Declining GP:</b> Can sum → converges</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="formula-box">
<span class="tex">Sum = <span class="frac"><span>First Term</span><span>1 - Common Ratio</span></span></span>
</div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Example: 64,32,16,8... (ratio 0.5) → Sum = 64/0.5 = 128</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-2">Verification with D₁=10, g=4%, r=12%</div>
<table class="pretty text-xs">
<thead><tr><th>Year</th><th>Dividend</th><th>PV</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>1</td><td>10.00</td><td>8.9286</td></tr>
<tr><td>2</td><td>10.40</td><td>8.2908</td></tr>
<tr><td>3</td><td>10.816</td><td>7.6986</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2">Common ratio of PVs = 0.9286 ✓ Declining GP<br/>Sum = 8.9286 / 0.0714 = <span class="num">₹125</span></div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Direct: D₁/(r−g) = 10/0.08 = <span class="num">₹125</span> ✓</div>
</div>
</div>

<h4 class="sub-title mb-3 mt-5">ITC Practical Valuation Example</h4>
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs">
<div><b class="text-cyan-300">CMP:</b> ₹279.10</div>
<div><b class="text-cyan-300">Dividend Yield:</b> 5.19%</div>
<div><b class="text-cyan-300">Next Dividend:</b> ₹10</div>
<div><b class="text-cyan-300">g:</b> 4% (Indian economy)</div>
<div><b class="text-cyan-300">r:</b> 12% (Nifty historical)</div>
<div><b class="text-cyan-300">Formula:</b> 10 / (0.12 − 0.04)</div>
</div>
<div class="calc-result mt-3 text-sm"><b class="text-emerald-300">Fair Value of ITC =</b> <span class="num text-lg">₹125</span> <span class="text-slate-400 text-xs">(AI tools refine to ₹250–₹278)</span></div>
<div class="quote mt-3 text-xs">Understand WHY DDM works for ITC but NOT for Reliance. <b>ITC Div Yield = 5.19% vs Reliance = 0.46%.</b></div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Preferred Stock Valuation -->
<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8 mb-5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"><span class="badge b-em">Special Case</span><h3 class="sub-title">Preferred Stock Valuation (g = 0)</h3></div>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div>
