let pv = 0;
let D = D0;
for(let t=1; t<=n; t++) {
D = D * (1 + g1/100);
pv += D / Math.pow(1 + r/100, t);
}
const D_next = D * (1 + g2/100);
const terminal = D_next / ((r - g2)/100);
pv += terminal / Math.pow(1 + r/100, n);
return pv.toFixed(2);
})()"></span></div>
<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Terminal value at Year <span data-xtext="n"></span> discounted to today + High-growth dividends discounted.</div>
</div>
</div>
<div data-xif="r <= g2">
<div class="calc-result mt-4 !border-rose-500/40 !bg-rose-500/5">
<div class="text-sm text-rose-300">⚠ Required return (r) must &gt; stable growth (g₂)</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="formulas" class="section-anchor mb-12">
<div class="section-head flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
<div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-500/20 to-violet-500/10 border border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center justify-center"><span class="lucide">🧮</span></div>
<div>
<div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-400 font-bold">Reference</div>
<h2 class="section-title text-white">Formula Vault</h2>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass p-6 md:p-8">
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">📘 Equity Securities</div>
<div class="space-y-3 text-sm">
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Book Value</div><span class="tex">BV = Equity Capital + Retained Earnings</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Price-to-Book Ratio</div><span class="tex">P/B = <span class="frac"><span>Market Price</span><span>BV per Share</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Return on Equity</div><span class="tex">ROE = <span class="frac"><span>Net Income</span><span>Average BV</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Average Book Value</div><span class="tex">Avg BV = <span class="frac"><span>Open BV + Close BV</span><span>2</span></span></span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-2">📗 DDM Family</div>
<div class="space-y-3 text-sm">
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Gordon Growth (Single-Stage)</div><span class="tex">P<sub>0</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>D<sub>1</sub></span><span>r-g</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Preferred Stock (g = 0)</div><span class="tex">P<sub>0</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>D</span><span>r</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Sustainable Growth Rate</div><span class="tex">g = ROE × (1 - DPR)</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Multi-Stage Terminal</div><span class="tex">P<sub>n</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>D<sub>n+1</sub></span><span>r-g</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Single Period DCF</div><span class="tex">P<sub>0</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>D<sub>1</sub> + P<sub>1</sub></span><span>1+r</span></span></span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-violet-400 mb-2">📕 Relative Valuation</div>
<div class="space-y-3 text-sm">
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">PE Ratio</div><span class="tex">PE = <span class="frac"><span>Price</span><span>EPS</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Fundamental Leading PE</div><span class="tex"><span class="frac"><span>P<sub>0</sub></span><span>E<sub>1</sub></span></span> = <span class="frac"><span>DPR</span><span>r - g</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Fundamental Trailing PE</div><span class="tex"><span class="frac"><span>P<sub>0</sub></span><span>E<sub>0</sub></span></span> = <span class="frac"><span>DPR(1+g)</span><span>r - g</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Enterprise Value</div><span class="tex">EV = Mkt Equity + Mkt Debt - Cash</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">EV/EBITDA</div><span class="tex"><span class="frac"><span>EV</span><span>EBITDA</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Equity Value</div><span class="tex">Equity = EV - Debt + Cash</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-amber-400 mb-2">📙 NAV & Market Structure</div>
<div class="space-y-3 text-sm">
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Net Asset Value</div><span class="tex">NAV = Fair Value Assets - Liabilities</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">NAV per Share</div><span class="tex">NAV/Share = <span class="frac"><span>NAV</span><span>Shares</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Leverage Ratio</div><span class="tex">LR = <span class="frac"><span>Asset</span><span>Equity</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">ROE with Leverage</div><span class="tex">ROE = Asset Return % × LR</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Margin Call Price</div><span class="tex">P<sup>*</sup> = <span class="frac"><span>P<sub>0</sub>(1-IM)</span><span>1-MM</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Short Selling Margin</div><span class="tex">Total w/Broker = Proceeds × (1 + Margin%)</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-rose-400 mb-2">📊 Indexes & Returns</div>
<div class="space-y-3 text-sm">
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Market Cap</div><span class="tex">MCap = Price × Outstanding Shares</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Free Float MCap</div><span class="tex">FF MCap = MCap × Public Holding %</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Stock Weight</div><span class="tex">w<sub>i</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>MCap<sub>i</sub></span><span>Σ MCap</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Price Return</div><span class="tex">R<sub>P</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>P<sub>1</sub> - P<sub>0</sub></span><span>P<sub>0</sub></span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Total Return</div><span class="tex">R<sub>T</sub> = <span class="frac"><span>P<sub>1</sub> + D - P<sub>0</sub></span><span>P<sub>0</sub></span></span></span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="glass-2 p-5">
<div class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-emerald-400 mb-2">⏱ Dates & Misc</div>
<div class="space-y-3 text-sm">
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Ex-Dividend Date</div><span class="tex">Ex-Div = Record Date - 1 Bus Day</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Dividend Growth</div><span class="tex">D<sub>1</sub> = D<sub>0</sub> × (1+g)</span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Earnings Yield</div><span class="tex">EY = <span class="frac"><span>Earnings</span><span>Price</span></span> = <span class="frac"><span>1</span><span>PE</span></span></span></div>
<div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Portfolio Value</div><span class="tex">V = Σ (Shares<sub>i</sub> × Price<sub>i</sub>)</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="question-bank" class="section-anchor mb-12">
<div class="section-head flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
<div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-500/20 to-amber-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 flex items-center justify-center"><span class="lucide">🧠</span></div>
<div>
<div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest text-rose-400 font-bold">Mastery Check</div>
<h2 class="section-title text-white">Complete Question Bank with Solutions</h2>
</div>
</div>

<div data-xdata="{qtab: 'equity'}" class="glass p-6 md:p-8">
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-5">
<button data-xclick="qtab='equity'" data-xclass="qtab==='equity'?'active':''" class="tab-btn">Equity Securities (Q1–7)</button>
<button data-xclick="qtab='valuation'" data-xclass="qtab==='valuation'?'active':''" class="tab-btn">Valuation (Q1–7)</button>

<!-- EQUITY SECURITIES Qs -->
<div data-xshow="qtab==='equity'" class="space-y-3">
<details class="glass-2 p-4" open><summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q1: Advantage of Participating Preference Shares?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary><div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">They receive EXTRA/SURPLUS dividend when company performs exceptionally well.</div></details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4"><summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q2: Benefit of Cumulative Voting?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary><div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">Minority shareholders get proportional board seat / representation on the board.</div></details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4"><summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q3: Which is NOT a characteristic of Private Equity?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary><div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">"Lower returns due to illiquidity" — INCORRECT. Private equity can give HIGHER returns.</div></details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4"><summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q4: GDR currency is always?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary><div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">USD — even though listed outside US (e.g., London).</div></details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4"><summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q5: Which preference type carries MOST risk?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary><div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">CALLABLE — capital gain capped by company.</div></details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4"><summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q6: Best describes Book Value of Equity?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary><div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">Management should try to maximize it (through retained earnings / reinvestment).</div></details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4"><summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q7: Rise in ROE is most likely positive when?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary><div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">Net Income rises FASTER than Book Value.</div></details>
</div>

<!-- VALUATION PART 1 Qs -->
<div data-xshow="qtab==='valuation'" class="space-y-3">
<details class="glass-2 p-4" open>
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q1: Analyst fair value = ₹45, CMP = ₹50</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">FV (₹45) &lt; CMP (₹50) → <b class="text-rose-300">OVERVALUED → DO NOT BUY.</b> Conditions: followed by FEW analysts, confident in model.</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q2: Free Cash Flow to Equity model maps to?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">(A) PRESENT VALUE MODEL — DCF method. <br/>Multiplier→Relative; Asset-based→NAV; PV→DCF.</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q3: 50% stock dividend vs 3-for-2 split — which lower price?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">90 shares × ₹150 = ₹13,500. <br/>Both result in 135 shares × ₹100 = ₹13,500. <br/><b class="text-emerald-300">Answer: BOTH have the SAME effect.</b></div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q4: First date buyer doesn't receive dividend?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">Ex-Dividend Date. Stock trades WITHOUT dividend entitlement. Price drops by dividend amount.</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q5: Single Period DCF — D₁=$1.05, sell $13.45, r=13.2%</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">CF = 1.05 + 13.45 = $14.50. PV = 14.50/1.132 = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">$12.81</b></div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q6: Multi Period DCF — D=$1.50 +8%/yr, sell $51 in 3 yrs, r=12%</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">Y3 CF = $1.8896 + $51 = $52.8896. <br/>PV1=1.4464, PV2=1.3948, PV3=37.637. <br/>Total = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">$40.48</b></div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q7: Requirement of Gordon Growth Formula?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">r &gt; g — Required rate MUST exceed growth rate.</div>
</details>
</div>

<!-- DDM Qs -->
<div data-xshow="qtab==='gordon'" class="space-y-3">
<details class="glass-2 p-4" open>
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q1: Preferred Stock Valuation (D=₹7, r=7.75%)</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">P₀ = 7 / 0.0775 = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">₹90.32</b> → Option C</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q2: One-Year Holding (D₁=₹2, P₁=₹40, r=15%)</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">P₀ = (2 + 40)/1.15 = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">₹36.52</b> → Option B</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q3: Gordon Growth (D₀=₹1, g=5%, r=10%)</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">D₁ = 1.05. P₀ = 1.05/(0.10−0.05) = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">₹21</b> → Option B</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q4: Two-Stage (D₁=1.25, D₂=1.56, g_thereafter=5%, r=11%)</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">D₃=1.638. P₂=1.638/0.06=27.30. Y2 CF=1.56+27.30=28.86. <br/>P₀ = 1.25/1.11 + 28.86/(1.11)² = 1.126+23.419 = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">₹24.54</b> → Option C</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q5: Multi-Stage (D₀=1, g₁=25% for 2yrs, g₂=6%, r=10%)</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">D₁=1.25, D₂=1.5625, D₃=1.6563. P₂=41.4063. <br/>Y2 CF=42.9688. P₀ = 1.25/1.10 + 42.9688/(1.10)² = 1.136+35.512 = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">₹36.64</b> → Option C</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q6: Best Company for Constant Growth Model?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">
(A) Biotechnology (2 yrs old) ✗ Too new<br/>
(B) Automobile Manufacturer ✗ Cyclical<br/>
<b class="text-emerald-300">(C) Bread & Snack Producer (FMCG) ✓</b> — daily necessities, stable, defensive, growth near economy.
</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q7: Deferred Dividend (D₄=0.82, g=5%, r=10%)</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">P₃ = 0.82/0.05 = ₹16.40. P₀ = 16.40/(1.10)³ = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">₹12.32</b></div>
</details>
</div>

<!-- RELATIVE VAL Qs -->
<div data-xshow="qtab==='rel'" class="space-y-3">
<details class="glass-2 p-4" open>
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q1: Least likely characteristic of price multiples?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">"They are insensitive to inputs" — <b class="text-rose-300">INCORRECT</b>. Multiples ARE sensitive to inputs. Change the multiple → valuation changes.</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q2: Fundamental PE (DPR=60%, g=7%, r=15%)</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">PE = 0.60/(0.15−0.07) = 0.60/0.08 = <b class="text-emerald-300 num">7.5x</b></div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q3: Meaning of Enterprise Value?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">Market Value of Equity + Market Value of Debt − Cash & Short-term Investments</div>
</details>
<details class="glass-2 p-4">
<summary class="flex items-center justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Q4: Most appropriate for Asset-Based Valuation (NAV)?</span><span class="lucide">▸</span></summary>
<div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300">
(A) Company in financial distress ✓ <b class="text-emerald-300">CORRECT</b><br/>
(B) High inflation ✗ NAV not used during hyperinflation<br/> (C) Software companies ✗ Intangible assets — not suitable for asset-based valuation</div></details></div></div>

<script>
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
MIDNIGHT SCHOLAR ENGINE — starfield, quiz, flashcards,
lab simulators, palette, pomodoro, progress & confetti
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
'use strict';
function $(s,c){return (c||document).querySelector(s);}
function $$(s,c){return Array.prototype.slice.call((c||document).querySelectorAll(s));}
function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
function on(id,ev,fn){var el=byId(id); if(el) el.addEventListener(ev,fn); return el;}
var RM=window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
var store={
get:function(k,d){try{var v=localStorage.getItem('cfa6:'+k);return v==null?d:JSON.parse(v);}catch(e){return d;}},
set:function(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem('cfa6:'+k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){}}
};

/* ---------- toast ---------- */
var toastTimer;
function toast(msg){var t=byId('toast');if(!t)return;t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');
clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('show');},2800);}

/* ---------- sound engine (WebAudio, no assets) ---------- */
var soundOn=store.get('sound',true), ac;
function blip(f,d,type,g,when){
if(!soundOn) return;
try{
var AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(!AC) return;
ac=ac||new AC(); if(ac.state==='suspended') ac.resume();
var t=ac.currentTime+(when||0);
var o=ac.createOscillator(),ga=ac.createGain();
o.type=type||'sine'; o.frequency.value=f;
ga.gain.setValueAtTime(g||0.05,t);
ga.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);
o.connect(ga); ga.connect(ac.destination);
o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+0.05);
}catch(e){}
}
function sfxCorrect(){blip(660,0.12);blip(880,0.16,'sine',0.05,0.1);}
function sfxWrong(){blip(170,0.22,'square',0.04);}
function sfxClick(){blip(520,0.05,'triangle',0.03);}
function sfxFanfare(){[523,659,784,1047].forEach(function(f,i){blip(f,0.18,'sine',0.05,i*0.12);});}
(function(){
var b=byId('soundToggle'); if(!b) return;
function paint(){b.textContent=soundOn?'🔊 Sound on':'🔇 Sound off';}
b.addEventListener('click',function(){soundOn=!soundOn;store.set('sound',soundOn);paint();if(soundOn)sfxClick();});
paint();
})();

/* ---------- scroll progress + rocket ---------- */
(function(){
var bar=byId('scrollProgress'),rocket=byId('rocket');
function onScroll(){
var h=document.documentElement,top=h.scrollTop||document.body.scrollTop;
var max=h.scrollHeight-h.clientHeight;
if(bar) bar.style.width=(max>0?top/max*100:0)+'%';
if(rocket) rocket.classList.toggle('show',top>600);
}
addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true}); onScroll();
if(rocket) rocket.addEventListener('click',function(){
rocket.classList.add('launch'); sfxClick();
scrollTo({top:0,behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth'});
setTimeout(function(){rocket.classList.remove('launch');},1000);
});
})();

/* ---------- starfield with shooting stars ---------- */
(function(){
var cv=byId('stars'); if(!cv) return;
var ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),stars=[],meteors=[],W,H;
function size(){W=cv.width=innerWidth;H=cv.height=innerHeight;}
size(); addEventListener('resize',size);
var N=Math.min(220,Math.floor(innerWidth*innerHeight/9000));
for(var i=0;i<N;i++) stars.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),r:Math.random()*1.4+0.3,
p:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,s:Math.random()*1.5+0.4,hue:Math.random()<0.12});
function paintStars(t,alphaFn){
for(var i=0;i<stars.length;i++){var s=stars[i],a=alphaFn(s,t);
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x*W,s.y*H,s.r,0,7);
ctx.fillStyle=s.hue?'rgba(0,217,255,'+a+')':'rgba(255,255,255,'+(a*0.85)+')';ctx.fill();}
}
if(RM){ paintStars(0,function(){return 0.5;}); return; }
function draw(t){
ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
paintStars(t,function(s){return 0.25+0.55*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.p+t*0.00045*s.s));});
if(Math.random()<0.004&&meteors.length<2)
meteors.push({x:Math.random()*W*0.8+W*0.2,y:Math.random()*H*0.3,
vx:-(4+Math.random()*5),vy:3+Math.random()*3,life:1});
for(var j=meteors.length-1;j>=0;j--){var m=meteors[j];
ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(180,240,255,'+m.life+')';ctx.lineWidth=1.6;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(m.x,m.y);ctx.lineTo(m.x-m.vx*8,m.y-m.vy*8);ctx.stroke();
m.x+=m.vx;m.y+=m.vy;m.life-=0.02;if(m.life<=0)meteors.splice(j,1);}
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
})();

/* ---------- cursor spotlight ---------- */
(function(){
if(RM) return; var spot=byId('spotlight'); if(!spot) return;
var sx=0,sy=0,tick=false;
addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
sx=e.clientX;sy=e.clientY;
if(!tick){tick=true;requestAnimationFrame(function(){
spot.style.setProperty('--mx',sx+'px');spot.style.setProperty('--my',sy+'px');tick=false;});}
},{passive:true});
})();

/* ---------- reveal on scroll ---------- */
(function(){
if(RM||!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
var els=$$('.card, .mini-card, .formula-item, .section-head, .glass');
els.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('js-reveal');});
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(en){
en.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}});
},{rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px',threshold:0.05});
els.forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});
})();

/* ---------- 3D tilt on hero meta cards ---------- */
if(!RM) $$('.meta-card').forEach(function(c){
c.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
var r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-0.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-0.5;
c.style.transform='perspective(600px) rotateY('+(x*10)+'deg) rotateX('+(-y*10)+'deg) translateY(-2px)';
});
c.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){c.style.transform='';});
});

/* ---------- scroll spy ---------- */
(function(){
if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
var map={};
$$('.nav-link').forEach(function(l){map[l.getAttribute('href').slice(1)]=l;});
var current=null;
var obs=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
entries.forEach(function(e){
if(e.isIntersecting&&map[e.target.id]){
if(current) current.classList.remove('active');
current=map[e.target.id]; current.classList.add('active');
}
});
},{rootMargin:'-20% 0px -60% 0px'});
$$('section[id]').forEach(function(s){obs.observe(s);});
})();

/* ---------- accent theme switcher ---------- */
(function(){
var ACCENTS={cyan:'#00d9ff',violet:'#a78bfa',emerald:'#2ecc71',amber:'#f39c12',pink:'#ff6bcb'};
function apply(name){
var c=ACCENTS[name]||ACCENTS.cyan;
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cyan',c);
store.set('accent',name);
$$('#accents .accent-dot').forEach(function(d){d.classList.toggle('sel',d.getAttribute('data-accent')===name);});
}
$$('#accents .accent-dot').forEach(function(d){
d.addEventListener('click',function(){apply(d.getAttribute('data-accent'));sfxClick();
toast('🎨 Accent switched to '+d.getAttribute('data-accent'));});
});
apply(store.get('accent','cyan'));
})();

/* ---------- confetti ---------- */
var confetti=(function(){
var cv=byId('confetti'); if(!cv) return function(){};
var ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),parts=[],run=null;
function step(){
ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
for(var i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){var p=parts[i];
p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.03;p.r+=p.vr;
ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(p.r);ctx.fillStyle=p.c;
ctx.fillRect(-p.s/2,-p.s/2,p.s,p.s*0.6);ctx.restore();
if(p.y>cv.height+30)parts.splice(i,1);}
if(parts.length){run=requestAnimationFrame(step);}
else{run=null;ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);}
}
return function(n){
if(RM) n=Math.min(n,40);
cv.width=innerWidth;cv.height=innerHeight;
var colors=['#00d9ff','#e94560','#2ecc71','#f39c12','#a78bfa','#ffffff'];
for(var i=0;i<n;i++) parts.push({x:Math.random()*cv.width,y:-20-Math.random()*cv.height*0.3,
vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*2.4,vy:2+Math.random()*3.5,s:4+Math.random()*6,
c:colors[i%colors.length],r:Math.random()*Math.PI,vr:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.25});
if(!run) run=requestAnimationFrame(step);
};
})();

/* ---------- studied progress ring ---------- */
var LOS=['ch1','ch2','ch3','ch4','ch5','ch6','ch7','ch8','ch9','ch10','ch11'];
var studied=store.get('studied',{});
var RINGLEN=119.38;
function paintProgress(){
var n=LOS.filter(function(id){return studied[id];}).length;
var fg=$('.ring-fg'); if(fg) fg.style.strokeDashoffset=String(RINGLEN*(1-n/LOS.length));
var lbl=byId('ringLabel'); if(lbl) lbl.innerHTML='<strong>'+n+'/11</strong> chapters studied';
LOS.forEach(function(id){
var link=$('.nav-link[href="#'+id+'"]'); if(link) link.classList.toggle('done',!!studied[id]);
var btn=$('#'+id+' .mark-btn');
if(btn){btn.classList.toggle('done',!!studied[id]);
btn.textContent=studied[id]?'✓ Studied':'○ Mark as studied';}
});
}
LOS.forEach(function(id){
var head=$('#'+id+' .section-head'); if(!head) return;
var btn=document.createElement('button');
btn.className='mark-btn'; btn.type='button';
btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
studied[id]=!studied[id]; store.set('studied',studied); paintProgress(); sfxClick();
var n=LOS.filter(function(i){return studied[i];}).length;
if(n===11){confetti(200);sfxFanfare();toast('🎓 ALL 11 CHAPTERS STUDIED — Equity Investments mastered!');}
});
head.appendChild(btn);
});
paintProgress();

/* ---------- pomodoro timer ---------- */
(function(){
var FOCUS=25*60,BREAK=5*60,left=FOCUS,mode='focus',run=null;
var elT=byId('pomoTime'),elS=byId('pomoStart'),elM=byId('pomoMode');
if(!elT||!elS||!elM) return;
function paint(){var m=Math.floor(left/60),s=left%60;
elT.textContent=(m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;}
function stop(){clearInterval(run);run=null;elS.textContent='▶';}
function swap(){mode=mode==='focus'?'break':'focus';left=mode==='focus'?FOCUS:BREAK;
elM.textContent=mode==='focus'?'FOCUS':'BREAK';paint();}
elS.addEventListener('click',function(){
if(run){stop();return;}
elS.textContent='⏸';
run=setInterval(function(){
left--; paint();
if(left<=0){stop();[880,880,1175].forEach(function(f,i){blip(f,0.25,'sine',0.07,i*0.35);});
toast(mode==='focus'?'⏰ Focus block done — take a 5 min break!':'☕ Break over — back to the books!');
swap();}
},1000);
});
on('pomoReset','click',function(){stop();left=mode==='focus'?FOCUS:BREAK;paint();});
elM.addEventListener('click',function(){stop();swap();});
paint();
})();

/* ---------- QUIZ MODE ---------- */
var quizState=store.get('quiz',{});
var qCards=$$('.question-card');
function quizScore(){
var done=0,ok=0;
qCards.forEach(function(c){var st=quizState[c.getAttribute('data-q')];if(st){done++;if(st.ok)ok++;}});
var bar=byId('quizBar'); if(bar) bar.style.width=(qCards.length?done/qCards.length*100:0)+'%';
var txt=byId('quizScore');
if(txt) txt.innerHTML='Score: <strong>'+ok+'</strong> / '+done+' answered · '+qCards.length+' total';
return {done:done,ok:ok};
}
qCards.forEach(function(card){
var q=card.getAttribute('data-q'),opts=$$('.option',card);
function settle(pickIdx){
card.classList.add('answered');
opts.forEach(function(o,i){
o.disabled=true;
if(o.hasAttribute('data-correct')) o.classList.add('correct');
if(i===pickIdx&&!o.hasAttribute('data-correct')) o.classList.add('wrong');
});
}
opts.forEach(function(o,i){
o.addEventListener('click',function(){
if(card.classList.contains('answered')) return;
var ok=o.hasAttribute('data-correct');
quizState[q]={pick:i,ok:ok}; store.set('quiz',quizState);
settle(i); ok?sfxCorrect():sfxWrong();
var s=quizScore();
if(s.done===qCards.length){
if(s.ok===qCards.length){confetti(180);sfxFanfare();toast('🏆 PERFECT 7/7 — efficiency expert!');}
else toast('📊 Quiz complete: '+s.ok+'/7 — review the red ones!');
}
});
});
var st=quizState[q]; if(st) settle(st.pick);
});
quizScore();
on('quizReveal','click',function(){
qCards.forEach(function(c){c.classList.add('revealed');});
sfxClick(); toast('👀 All solutions revealed — score unaffected');
});
on('quizReset','click',function(){
quizState={}; store.set('quiz',quizState);
qCards.forEach(function(c){
c.classList.remove('answered','revealed');
$$('.option',c).forEach(function(o){o.disabled=false;o.classList.remove('correct','wrong');});
});
quizScore(); sfxClick(); toast('🔄 Quiz reset — good luck!');
});

/* ---------- FLASHCARDS ---------- */
var DECKS={
definitions:[["Overview of Equity Securities", "Types of equity & preference shares, voting systems, dual-class structures, public vs private, ADR/GDR/GRS, book vs market value, ROE vs required return"], ["Equity Valuation — Concepts", "CMP vs intrinsic value, valuation method families, dividends & corporate actions, dividend chronology, DCF numericals"], ["Dividend Discount Models", "Gordon Growth Model, preferred stock (g=0), sustainable growth rate, two-stage DDM, deferred dividend problems"], ["Relative Valuation & EV/EBITDA", "Method of comparable, fundamental PE from GGM, EV/EBITDA for manufacturers"], ["Net Asset Value (NAV)", "Asset-based floor value, master decision table, advantages & disadvantages of all methods"], ["Market Efficiency & Behavioral Finance", "Four forms master table, six efficiency factors, anomalies, six behavioral biases"], ["Security Market Indexes", "Price vs total return, five weight systems with numericals, construction decisions, rebalancing vs reconstitution"], ["Market Organization & Structure", "Financial system functions, leverage & margin calls, order types & matching, primary markets, SEBI"], ["Company Analysis — Past & Present", "Equity research reports, business models, cost & leverage analysis, cash conversion cycle"], ["Industry & Competitive Analysis", "Industry size & HHI, GICS classification, Porter's five forces, PESTLE, generic strategies"], ["Company Analysis — Forecasting", "Revenue drives everything, bottom-up vs top-down, cost forecasting, five methods, scenarios"]],
formulas:[["Book Value", "BV = Equity Capital + Retained Earnings"], ["Price-to-Book Ratio", "P/B = Market Price"], ["Return on Equity", "ROE = Net Income"], ["Average Book Value", "Avg BV = Open BV + Close BV"], ["Gordon Growth (Single-Stage)", "P0 = D1"], ["Preferred Stock (g = 0)", "P0 = D"], ["Sustainable Growth Rate", "g = ROE × (1 - DPR)"], ["Multi-Stage Terminal", "Pn = Dn+1"], ["Single Period DCF", "P0 = D1 + P1"], ["PE Ratio", "PE = Price"], ["Fundamental Leading PE", "P0"], ["Fundamental Trailing PE", "P0"], ["Enterprise Value", "EV = Mkt Equity + Mkt Debt - Cash"], ["EV/EBITDA", "EV"], ["Equity Value", "Equity = EV - Debt + Cash"], ["Net Asset Value", "NAV = Fair Value Assets - Liabilities"], ["NAV per Share", "NAV/Share = NAV"], ["Leverage Ratio", "LR = Asset"], ["ROE with Leverage", "ROE = Asset Return % × LR"], ["Margin Call Price", "P^* = P0(1-IM)"], ["Short Selling Margin", "Total w/Broker = Proceeds × (1 + Margin%)"], ["Market Cap", "MCap = Price × Outstanding Shares"], ["Free Float MCap", "FF MCap = MCap × Public Holding %"], ["Stock Weight", "wi = MCapi"], ["Price Return", "RP = P1 - P0"], ["Total Return", "RT = P1 + D - P0"], ["Ex-Dividend Date", "Ex-Div = Record Date - 1 Bus Day"], ["Dividend Growth", "D1 = D0 × (1+g)"], ["Earnings Yield", "EY = Earnings"], ["Portfolio Value", "V = Σ (Sharesi × Pricei)"]]
};
(function(){
var card=byId('fcCard'); if(!card) return;
var fc={deck:'definitions',i:0,flipped:false,known:store.get('fcKnown',{definitions:{},formulas:{}})};
function deck(){return DECKS[fc.deck];}
function knownMap(){fc.known[fc.deck]=fc.known[fc.deck]||{};return fc.known[fc.deck];}
function paint(){
var d=deck(),item=d[fc.i],km=knownMap();
byId('fcTerm').textContent=item[0];
byId('fcDef').textContent=item[1];
byId('fcCount').textContent=(fc.i+1)+' / '+d.length;
var n=d.filter(function(it){return km[it[0]];}).length;
byId('fcKnown').textContent='✅ Known: '+n+' / '+d.length;
card.classList.toggle('flipped',fc.flipped);
card.classList.toggle('known',!!km[item[0]]);
$$('.fc-tab').forEach(function(t){t.classList.toggle('sel',t.getAttribute('data-deck')===fc.deck);});
}
function go(delta){fc.flipped=false;fc.i=(fc.i+delta+deck().length)%deck().length;paint();sfxClick();}
function flip(){fc.flipped=!fc.flipped;paint();}
card.addEventListener('click',flip);
on('fcFlip','click',flip);
on('fcPrev','click',function(){go(-1);});
on('fcNext','click',function(){go(1);});
on('fcShuffle','click',function(){
var d=deck();
for(var i=d.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)),t=d[i];d[i]=d[j];d[j]=t;}
fc.i=0;fc.flipped=false;paint();toast('🔀 Deck shuffled');
});
on('fcKnow','click',function(){knownMap()[deck()[fc.i][0]]=true;store.set('fcKnown',fc.known);sfxCorrect();go(1);});
on('fcReview','click',function(){knownMap()[deck()[fc.i][0]]=false;store.set('fcKnown',fc.known);go(1);});
$$('.fc-tab').forEach(function(t){
t.addEventListener('click',function(){fc.deck=t.getAttribute('data-deck');fc.i=0;fc.flipped=false;paint();sfxClick();});
});
addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
if(e.target.tagName==='INPUT'||e.target.tagName==='TEXTAREA') return;
var sec=byId('flashcards'); if(!sec) return;
var r=sec.getBoundingClientRect();
if(!(r.top<innerHeight*0.7&&r.bottom>innerHeight*0.3)) return;
if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){go(-1);e.preventDefault();}
else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){go(1);e.preventDefault();}
else if(e.key===' '){flip();e.preventDefault();}
});
paint();
})();

/* ---------- mini reactive shim (replaces Alpine subset) ---------- */
$$('[data-xdata]').forEach(function(root){
var scope;
try{ scope=new Function('return ('+root.getAttribute('data-xdata')+')')(); }catch(e){ scope={}; }
function ev(expr){ try{ return new Function('s','with(s){return ('+expr+')}')(scope); }catch(e){ return ''; } }
function paint(){
$$('[data-xtext]',root).forEach(function(el){ el.textContent=ev(el.getAttribute('data-xtext')); });
$$('[data-xshow]',root).forEach(function(el){ el.style.display=ev(el.getAttribute('data-xshow'))?'':'none'; });
$$('[data-xif]',root).forEach(function(el){ el.style.display=ev(el.getAttribute('data-xif'))?'':'none'; });
$$('[data-xclass]',root).forEach(function(el){
if(!el.dataset.baseClass) el.dataset.baseClass=el.className;
var extra=ev(el.getAttribute('data-xclass'));
el.className=el.dataset.baseClass+(extra?' '+extra:'');
});
}
$$('[data-xmodel]',root).forEach(function(inp){
var k=inp.getAttribute('data-xmodel');
if(scope[k]!==undefined) inp.value=scope[k];
inp.addEventListener('input',function(){
var v=parseFloat(inp.value); scope[k]=isNaN(v)?inp.value:v; paint();
});
});
$$('[data-xclick]',root).forEach(function(btn){
btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
try{ new Function('s','with(s){'+btn.getAttribute('data-xclick')+'}')(scope); }catch(e){}
paint(); sfxClick();
});
});
paint();
});

/* ---------- command palette ---------- */
var palOpen=false,palSel=0,palItems=[],PAL=[];
$$('.nav-link').forEach(function(a){PAL.push({t:a.textContent.trim(),h:a.getAttribute('href')});});
qCards.forEach(function(c){
var qt=$('.question-text',c);
PAL.push({t:'❓ '+c.getAttribute('data-q').toUpperCase()+' — '+(qt?qt.textContent.slice(0,64):''),h:'#'+c.id});
});

function paintSel(){
$$('#palList li').forEach(function(li,i){
li.classList.toggle('sel',i===palSel);
if(i===palSel&&li.scrollIntoView) li.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
});
}
function palGo(i){
var p=palItems[i]; if(!p) return;
closePal();
var el=$(p.h); if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});
sfxClick();
}
function palFilter(q){
q=(q||'').toLowerCase();
palItems=PAL.filter(function(p){return p.t.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1;});
palSel=0;
var ul=byId('palList');
ul.innerHTML=palItems.length
?palItems.map(function(p,i){return '<li data-i="'+i+'"'+(i===0?' class="sel"':'')+'></li>';}).join('')
:'<li class="empty">No matches…</li>';
$$('#palList li[data-i]').forEach(function(li,i){
li.textContent=palItems[i].t;
li.addEventListener('click',function(){palGo(i);});
});
}
function openPal(){
var o=byId('palette'); if(!o) return;
o.classList.add('open'); palOpen=true;
var inp=byId('palInput'); inp.value=''; palFilter('');
setTimeout(function(){inp.focus();},30);
}
function closePal(){var o=byId('palette');if(o)o.classList.remove('open');palOpen=false;}
on('palInput','input',function(){palFilter(this.value);});
on('palette','click',function(e){if(e.target===this)closePal();});
$$('.open-palette').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',openPal);});

/* ---------- keyboard shortcuts ---------- */
var SECTIONS=['ch1','ch2','ch3','ch4','ch5','ch6','ch7','ch8','ch9','ch10','ch11','calculators','formulas','question-bank','flashcards'];
function currentSectionIdx(){
var best=0;
SECTIONS.forEach(function(id,i){
var el=byId(id);
if(el&&el.getBoundingClientRect().top<innerHeight*0.35) best=i;
});
return best;
}
function jump(i){var el=byId(SECTIONS[i]);if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth'});}
on('keys','click',function(e){if(e.target===this)this.classList.remove('open');});
addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
if(palOpen){
if(e.key==='Escape') closePal();
else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'){palSel=Math.min(palSel+1,palItems.length-1);paintSel();e.preventDefault();}
else if(e.key==='ArrowUp'){palSel=Math.max(palSel-1,0);paintSel();e.preventDefault();}
else if(e.key==='Enter'){palGo(palSel);}
return;
}
if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&(e.key==='k'||e.key==='K')){e.preventDefault();openPal();return;}
if(e.target.tagName==='INPUT'||e.target.tagName==='TEXTAREA'||e.target.isContentEditable) return;
if(e.key==='?'){var k=byId('keys');if(k)k.classList.toggle('open');}
else if(e.key==='n'||e.key==='j'){jump(Math.min(currentSectionIdx()+1,SECTIONS.length-1));}
else if(e.key==='p'||e.key==='k'){jump(Math.max(currentSectionIdx()-1,0));}
else if(e.key==='Escape'){var k2=byId('keys');if(k2)k2.classList.remove('open');}
});

/* ---------- mobile drawer ---------- */
(function(){
var sb=$('.sidebar'),bd=byId('backdrop');
function close(){if(sb)sb.classList.remove('open');if(bd)bd.classList.remove('show');}
on('hamburger','click',function(){
if(sb)sb.classList.toggle('open');
if(bd)bd.classList.toggle('show');
});
if(bd) bd.addEventListener('click',close);
$$('.sidebar .nav-link').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',close);});
})();

/* ---------- konami easter egg ---------- */
(function(){
var SEQ=['arrowup','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','arrowleft','arrowright','b','a'],idx=0;
addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
var k=(e.key||'').toLowerCase();
if(k===SEQ[idx]){
idx++;
if(idx===SEQ.length){
idx=0;
document.body.classList.add('rainbow');
confetti(250); sfxFanfare();
toast('🎓 SCHOLAR MODE UNLOCKED — may your ROE always beat your required rate!');
setTimeout(function(){document.body.classList.remove('rainbow');},8000);
}
} else idx=(k===SEQ[0])?1:0;
});
})();

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
